description: The lights of Annie's Bar and the Indian Runner for the modern lighting (rt_lights, docs/RENDER.md section 10). At night, no sun. The lamps are the models the cell ER0300 draws lit (its other fixtures are drawn dark and stay off): four fluorescent tubes (KEIKO, about 1.9 m up) and a row of five small ceiling lamps (AKARI, 3.16 m up). Positions are metres, PS1 axes (y down), just below each fixture; weak and short, so the room keeps the original's dim tint and the fog bounds them.
